paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc takes two wins over Mooreville into its Thanksgiving soccer break. The girls won a shootout 3–1 after the teams finished level at 1–1 in Ecru on Nov. 17. The boys followed with a 7–0 win, their fifth straight to open the season.

Neither girls team scored in the first half, and each scored once in the second. North Pontotoc’s goal went to Mary Crotwell, with Kyndall Roberts credited with the assist. They also lead the Vikings in those categories heading into the break. The Booneville matchup lists seven goals for Crotwell and three assists for Roberts.

The North Pontotoc boys have scored 35 goals and allowed five in their five posted matches. They shut out Houston 8–0, won 3–1 at Pontotoc, then kept Mooreville off the board. The first two wins came against Tupelo Christian Prep and Kosciusko.

Both Vikings teams are scheduled to play at Booneville on Tuesday, Dec. 1. The girls kick off at 5 p.m. and the boys at 7 p.m. Booneville’s boys had five wins in five posted finals as of Sunday, including three shutouts. Their Nov. 20 game against Shannon still had no score on the Blue Devils’ schedule.
